display_long_description:
# Match Point Tennis: Join over 1 million players world wide!
Match Point Tennis is free-to-play VR tennis , now with PRO TOUR: Paris Invitational. Real tournament brackets, 42 rivals, six Parisian clay stadium courts, and crowds that react to every point.
[media]

[media]
Free to Try: every player gets a guest pass into the Group of 16. Lose, and try again, no penalty, just another shot. Win, and see what's beyond it.

[media]
# PRO TOUR unlocks the full bracket: 
MPT 250, MPT 500, and MPT 1000, ending in a night final against Bastien Leroy, ranked #1. 12 Legendary cosmetics are earned only by winning rounds — not purchasable, not random.
[media]

# Ranked Multiplayer with Leaderboards
Battle AI opponents, train, or compete in Public, Private, and Ranked multiplayer matches. 
[media]

# Earn Your Career 
Earn XP, unlock 64 achievement trophies, customize your avatar and racket across four rarity tiers, and climb the Seasonal and All Time leaderboards.
[media]

# Play on hard, grass, and clay courts, each tuned with distinct bounce and feel.
Over 16 New Courts, Including Paris, Amsterdam, Melbourne, Rhode Island, and many more
[media] 
Match Point Tennis is free to play. PRO is a one-time purchase unlocking the full tournament, private lobbies, leaderboards, and Epic/Legendary cosmetics.

Serve. Rally. Unlock. Rise.
Match Point Tennis.
